visualStyle: Monochrome historical photographic reconstruction with soft vintage optics, natural continuous tonal shading, gently faded silver-print feel, visible irregular grain and random noise, a few subtle dust specks and fine micro-scratches. sceneBrief: 1425 Han River hill pavilion in welcome rain: view from a modest wooden pavilion toward drought-stricken fields receiving rain; a royal party seen from behind under the eaves, farmers in distance. No identifiable royal face, no modern skyline.
